question_cn: 为什么在开局阶段要优先控制中心？
question_en: Why should you prioritize controlling the center in the opening?

options.text_cn: 可以更快完成王车易位
占据中心的棋子活动空间更大，可控制棋盘更多区域
options.text_en: Pieces in the center have greater mobility and control more of the board.

options.text_cn: 可以防止对方走弃兵开局
options.text_en: It prevents the opponent from playing a gambit.

options.text_cn: 中心格的兵不容易被吃掉
options.text_en: Pawns on central squares are harder to capture.

explanation_cn: 站在中心的棋子（尤其是马）能到达的格子数量远多于边路棋子。控制中心意味着你的棋子有更多活动空间，可以灵活调度到棋盘任何位置发动进攻或防守。
explanation_en: A piece in the center, especially a knight, can reach far more squares than one on the edge. Controlling the center gives your pieces mobility and lets you shift them flexibly to attack or defend across the board.
